conceptZh: 玩具騎士擺出超帥的架式緩緩拔劍，拔出來的卻是一支牙刷；他整個僵住、若無其事地把牙刷放回鞘裡，重新擺一次架式，這回才順利拔出真正的寶劍，帥氣地舉高敬禮。
object: a small toy knight with a scabbard
morph: the glyph 劍 stands still as a solid sculpture while the drawing-the-sword gag plays out beside it
creativeAngle: 對上孩子喜歡的英雄武器，但完全沒有打鬥：笑點是「超帥的動作配上完全不對的道具」，而且給他第二次機會成功收尾，情緒是好玩不是出糗。劍十五畫且左邊僉部筆畫密，字體靜止保結構。語音詞「寶劍」，寶ㄅㄠˇ、劍ㄐㄧㄢˋ都是單一讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale peach background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 劍 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep steel blue, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the dense 僉 component on the left and the narrow 刂 on the right stay clearly separated, with every horizontal stroke inside 僉 evenly spaced and never merging. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. Beside its lower right stands a small toy knight in rounded plastic armour, one hand resting on the scabbard at his hip. From 0.7 seconds he takes a slow, magnificent stance - feet planted, cape settling, chin lifted - and begins to draw, drawing out the moment as long as possible. At 2.0 seconds the blade clears the scabbard and it is a toothbrush. He holds it aloft anyway for one frozen beat, visor blank. At 2.6 seconds he quietly lowers it, slides it back in, glances left and right to check nobody saw, and resets his stance exactly as before. At 3.4 seconds he draws again and this time a proper stubby toy sword comes out cleanly; he raises it in a crisp salute, gives a satisfied nod, and marches out of frame to the right by 4.6 seconds. From 4.7 seconds to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 劍 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「劍、劍、寶劍」, using the reading ㄐㄧㄢˋ for 劍 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 劍 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 寶劍 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. Keep the whole scene gentle and playful: no fighting, no striking anything, no scary poses and no loud metallic clangs. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 劍: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.
